items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Johnny Matoia. He died. He was the best friend that Zulu's ever had.

ctx.x: That's how you pronounce his name?
Matoia. Johnny Matoia. He died. He was the best friend that Zulu's ever had.

He ever said Boston. Johnny Matoia. He would have been a friend of mine twice. Would he be the Grand Marshal at the parade? He would have been a friend of Zulu. But he wouldn't march in front of the band? No, sometimes, but he would kill that. He'd be a friend of the Riding Lord over here. Oh, yeah, I see. Who was the best Grand Marshal, do you think, ever something for really stepping and strutting?
